name: New design document
description: Create a blank design canvas from the dashboard or the in-editor New page action.
completeness_note: New page creates a design canvas at preset sizes (editor/canvas_presets.js) and pushes a page node into the store; no templates gallery beyond the AI layout node/store templates.

name: Open .voo project file
description: Open the native .voo project container (document + embedded image bytes) from disk or browser.
completeness_note: Reads the v1 JSON-forward .voo envelope and rehydrates images into the IDB blob map. Multi-page documents supported through pages[].

name: Save / Save As .voo
description: Save the current document back to .voo, via native dialog on desktop and download/FSA on web.
completeness_note: Manual Photoshop-style save is the desktop contract; there is no cloud/versioned save.

name: Save As SVG / PSD / FIG
description: Save the document back out as SVG, Photoshop PSD or Figma .fig with a pre-save loss report.
completeness_note: Works but lossy by design: SVG writer only represents rect/ellipse/path/boolean/text/image (SVG_WRITABLE_KINDS), .fig writer only frames/rect/ellipse with solid fills (figSaveLosses), PSD flattens unsupported nodes. Multi-page is dropped in all three.

name: Autosave / crash recovery
description: Debounced draft autosave and crash-recovery snapshot of editor documents.
completeness_note: The saver exists (600 ms debounce, per-page dirty tracking) but the hook returns a no-op when `disabled` is true, and the header comment states that in the standalone desktop app background autosave is disabled in favour of manual Ctrl+S. Recovery therefore depends on explicit saves in the shipped desktop build.

name: Recent files + welcome dashboard
description: Dashboard with Recents/Drafts/Starred/Trash, folders, search, sort and quick actions.
completeness_note: Local-only (localStorage + workspace driver); no cloud drafts, no team libraries. 'Import Figma' quick action is present as a dashboard card.

name: Workspace folders / trash
description: Project workspace with folders, rename, duplicate, star, trash/restore/empty on all three storage drivers.
completeness_note: Three drivers (Electron FS, Web File System Access, IndexedDB virtual) share one facade; trash is a `.trash/` subfolder emulation.

name: Share by link / live room
description: Share a document through a live P2P collaboration room link.
completeness_note: shareWorkflow() reads `get().collabSession`, but no code in src/ ever creates a collabSession (grep `collabSession` ⇒ only share_actions.js), and collab/use_collab.js is a standalone stub returning status 'off'. The share action therefore cannot start a room in this build.
notes: Search: grep -rn collabSession src/ ⇒ 1 hit; grep -rn 'collab/session' src/ ⇒ only the definition in src/canvas/collab/session.js.

name: CanvasKit/Skia scene renderer
description: GPU-accelerated Skia rendering path for the design stage via the vendored voo-canvas-core package.
completeness_note: Skia is an alternate host; the default stage still paints through the Canvas2D renderer (render_nodes.js/render_canvas_base.js), with GL shader paths for adjustments.

name: Canvas2D node renderer
description: Per-node paint dispatch for shapes, paths, images, text, booleans, video frames and effects.
completeness_note: Node renderers are split per kind (render_path_node, render_image_node, render_boolean_node, render_video_node, render_figma_effects).

name: Zoom, pan, fit-to-screen
description: Viewport camera with zoom steps, pan, fit scale, and panel-aware fit insets.
completeness_note: Fit accounts for floating panels and the add-canvas rail (editor_panel_layout.js). Blend-tile quality settles 250 ms after the last view change.

name: Grid snapping (rect + isometric)
description: Snap moved/resized layers to a rectangular or isometric grid.
completeness_note: Two separate things: (a) the view-only grid overlay is drawn (chrome_draw.js line 245, toggled by EditorActions onToggleGrid -> engine.setGrid, never exported); (b) grid-snap maths exists in snapNodeBounds for rectangular and isometric grids, but both call sites (editor_pointer_move.js line 361, editor_pointer_transform.js line 529/638) call snapNodeBounds with NO options object, so options.snapToGrid stays false and grid snapping is unreachable from the UI. Object/guide/equal-spacing snapping does run (defaults true).

name: Smart alignment guides + equal-spacing guides
description: Figma-style magenta alignment guides, equal-gap detection, spaced measuring pills, alt-bypass.
completeness_note: Well covered: gap_h/gap_v paired descriptors, zoom-adaptive thresholds, anti-jitter (gap <= 4 px rejected), hidden/active node exclusion.

name: Rulers + ruler guides
description: Document rulers with draggable guides, as in Figma/Photoshop.

evidence.locator: line 151 comment 'Guide lines from the rulers persist with the document.'

completeness_note: `doc.guides` is persisted and consumed by snapping (scene_snapping.js line 128), but there is no ruler component and no UI to create/drag guides. Searches: grep -rni 'ruler' src/ ⇒ 1 hit (that serialisation comment); grep -rn 'guides' src/canvas/components/ ⇒ 0 hits. So guides exist only as data a hand-written file could carry.

name: Viewport culling
description: Skip painting layers fully outside the visible stage (240 px world margin).
completeness_note: Only nodes whose pixels cannot depend on other nodes are eligible (booleans/clipping excluded).

name: Multi-page documents / canvas tabs
description: Several design canvases in one project with a tab bar and page index.
completeness_note: Pages are store nodes of kind design with their own engine; the tab bar navigates them. Presentation reuses pages as slides.

name: Tool set (34 tool ids)
description: Full editor tool registry: select, distort, perspective, puppet warp, region, marquee, wand, brush, shapes, pen, text, crop, eraser, healing, retouch, blur/sharpen/smudge/dodge/burn/sponge, lasso, dropper, fill, gradient.
completeness_note: TOOL enum has 34 ids; the toolbar shows 9 primary tools and the rest are reached through families/shortcut cycling or the tool subbar.

name: Floating toolbar + tool subbars
description: Primary toolbar with flyouts and per-family sub-bars (shape, pen, marquee, lasso, healing, fill, pie).
completeness_note: Toolbar tools: select, perspective, distort, puppet warp, region, brush, crop, eraser, text (9). Sub-bars add shapes/marquee/lasso/healing/fill variants.

name: Single-key tool switching with family cycling
description: Figma/Photoshop-style V/A/M/W/L/B/J/P/R/O/G keys, re-press to cycle family, Shift variants.
completeness_note: Tested routing table without React, incl. Photoshop toggle-back (V→B→B→V) and shift bindings (⇧P free pen, ⇧L arrow).

name: Shape tools (rect, ellipse, line, polygon, star, arrow)
description: Draw six vector shape primitives with modifier keys.
completeness_note: Each shape is also a command-table command (draw_rect/draw_ellipse/draw_line/draw_polygon/draw_star/draw_arrow) so the agent can draw them too.

name: Pen tool family (pen, curvature pen, free pen)
description: Bezier pen with anchor/corner/smooth subtools, curvature pen and freehand pencil.
completeness_note: Supports shape/path modes, add/remove anchor, close path, and pen-draft editing (editor_pen_edit.js, editor_pen_draft.js).

name: Brush family with retouch modes
description: Paint brush plus smudge, blur, sharpen, dodge, burn and sponge retouch modes, pressure support.
completeness_note: Brush presets (.abr parser abr_parser.js, brush_presets.js) and pressure (brush_pressure.js) exist. No tests directly for brush stroke compositing.

name: Healing tools (AI repair, spot, patch, clone)
description: Four healing sub-modes including local AI repair.
completeness_note: Healing modes share TOOL.HEALING; AI repair requires the local repair model (ai_capabilities.js).

name: Region / marquee / wand / lasso selection tools
description: Pixel-object region selection, rectangular & elliptical marquee, magic wand, freehand and magnetic lasso.
completeness_note: Selection modes cycle with M/L/Z; wand has tolerance/contiguous controls (pixel_selection_wand.js, selection_wand_controls.jsx). Magnetic lasso has its own settings module but no test file.

name: Crop tool
description: Crop with free/aspect/fixed-size modes, rotation and crop panel fields.
completeness_note: Three crop modes (crop_geometry.js comment) with numeric size fields; destructive crop in crop_destructive.js.

name: Eyedropper, fill, gradient
description: Colour picker from canvas, flood fill, and linear/radial gradient tool.
completeness_note: Eyedropper has a gate module (eyedropper_gate.js) for when sampling is permitted.

name: Perspective / distort / puppet warp tools
description: Four-corner perspective transform, distort, and puppet-warp pin deformation as first-class tools.
completeness_note: Geometry, mesh and render modules exist (puppet_warp_mesh.js, mesh_transform*.js) but there are no tests for puppet/mesh/warp (grep -rli 'puppet' tests/ ⇒ 0; 'warp' ⇒ 0), so the interactive path is unverified.

name: Rect/ellipse marquee selection
description: Drag marquee with add/subtract/intersect modes.
completeness_note: Selection is a pixel mask (Uint8/alpha) with contour extraction (pixel_selection_contour.js) and morphology (feather/expand/contract/smooth).

name: Lasso + magnetic lasso
description: Freehand lasso and edge-snapping magnetic lasso with tolerance/frequency settings.
completeness_note: Magnetic lasso is a full cost-graph implementation (geometry + heap + source/settings modules) with no dedicated test file.

name: Magic wand (colour range)
description: Colour-tolerance contiguous wand selection.
completeness_note: Tolerance and contiguous controls in the properties panel; no unit test for pixel_selection_wand.js.

name: Selection refine (feather/expand/contract/smooth)
description: Refine an existing pixel selection with feather, expand, contract and smooth operations.
completeness_note: Exposed both as a context-menu entry ('Feather selection') and as agent command refine_selection; no unit test for the morphology kernels.

name: Free transform / scale / rotate / skew
description: Selection bounding box with corner handles, rotate, skew, and box transform maths.
completeness_note: Free transform, bake (transform_api_bake.js) and puppet transform APIs are separate slices.

name: Align + distribute + equal spacing
description: Six align buttons, horizontal/vertical distribute, tidy, and gap measurement/setting.
completeness_note: Very well covered (51 tests in the smart-spacing suite): mixed sizes, negative free space, degenerate N, custom gap, stable ordering.

name: Power duplicate + arrays
description: Repeat-transform duplication and linear/grid/circular array generators.
completeness_note: Three array modes with validation modules (scene-linear-array-validation.js, scene-circular-array-validation.js) surfaced as property sections.

name: Layer ordering, grouping, clipping
description: Bring/send, forward/backward, group/ungroup, clipping mask create/release.
completeness_note: Context menu exposes group/ungroup, forward/back/front/back, create & release clip mask.

name: Boolean operations (union/subtract/intersect/exclude)
description: Non-destructive boolean nodes with a polygon clipping engine and live re-render.
completeness_note: Strongest-tested area: 37 e2e boolean tests + 27 topological invariants + 22 stress. Curve segments are adaptively flattened to polygons for clipping.

name: Path anchor editing
description: Select/move anchors and handles, add/remove nodes, corner/smooth conversion, close path.
completeness_note: The command table exposes add_pen_node for the agent; the pen subbar (editor_pen_subbar.jsx) and menu list anchor/subtool modes.

name: Expand stroke to path
description: Convert a stroke into an outline path.
completeness_note: 34 e2e tests cover stroke joins, caps and degenerate paths.

name: Offset path
description: Inset/outset a path by a distance.
completeness_note: Tested for both pure geometry and node-level application (12 + 6 tests).

name: Corner radius / corner smoothing
description: Uniform and per-corner radii on rects and paths, with radius handles.
completeness_note: Radii drive the renderer and the export writers (resolveCornerRadii used in SVG/HTML output).

name: Stroke style + fill kinds
description: Stroke width/cap/join/align/dash, solid and gradient fills, fill rules.
completeness_note: Gradient model in gradient_model.js with stops bar UI (GradientStopsBar.jsx). Independent stroke alignment is supported (resolveStrokeAlign).

name: Path actions menu
description: Convert to path, path-to-shape, path-to-selection, type on path attach/detach, edit SVG.
completeness_note: 8 tests cover the action table; context menu wires the same actions.

name: SVG import/export
description: Parse SVG files into editable nodes and serialise documents to SVG.
completeness_note: SVG parsing is split across xml/shapes/text/image/style modules; export round-trip losses are reported (svgSaveLosses).

name: Text tool with auto-sizing
description: Click/drag text boxes, edit inline on canvas, commit on Escape.
completeness_note: Text lives on a DOM overlay while editing; width/height are baked from measured metrics (text_metrics.js) so a late font load triggers a re-measure.

name: Bundled + Google font library
description: Bundled OFL families plus a 1,949-entry Google Fonts index, searchable in the font picker.
completeness_note: Fonts are fetched from Google on demand; there is no local/system-font enumeration (grep 'system font|localFont' in font_loader.js/font_picker.jsx ⇒ 0 hits), so an offline user only gets the bundled families.

name: Variable font weights
description: Numeric weight 100-900 selection for variable faces plus legacy keyword states.
completeness_note: Weights are exposed as a select row (text_section.jsx). Only weight is variable-axis aware — no width/slant/optical-size axis UI (grep 'fontVariation|font-variation-settings' in src/ ⇒ 1 hit, in Figma import only).

name: Reusable named text styles
description: Create/apply shared text styles across layers, like Figma text styles.
completeness_note: 'Text style' here is only the per-node style panel (a CollapsibleSection), not a reusable style object. Searches: grep -rni 'textStyles|text_styles' src/ ⇒ 0 definitions of a document style collection; grep -rni 'styleId|styleRef' in scene model ⇒ 0 hits. No style library, no apply-style semantics.

name: Text on path
description: Attach text to a path, distribute/align along it, and detach back to a text layer.
completeness_note: 17 + 3 tests; attach/detach also exposed in the path context menu (editor.menu.path.attachText / detachText).

name: IME / composition input
description: Composition-aware text entry for CJK IMEs.
completeness_note: Component exists and is mounted by the text overlay; there is no unit test that drives composition events (validation is i18n/manual).

name: Text effects (shadow, stroke, gradient fill)
description: Per-node text shadow, text stroke and fill effects normalised with node effects.
completeness_note: Effects share the node effects shape (shadow/glow/innerShadow/innerGlow/satin/bevel/fill/gradientOverlay/stroke).

name: Auto layout for groups/frames
description: Opt-in horizontal/vertical reflow on groups with gap, padding, alignment and space-between.
completeness_note: Model + panel exist (direction/gap/padding/align/justify) and reflow is pure scene math, but there is no test for auto layout (grep -rli 'auto_layout|autoLayout' tests/ ⇒ 0) and no resize-to-hug/fill sizing rules beyond content width. Figma's frame sizing modes are not present.

name: Resize constraints (pin left/right/center/scale)
description: Figma-style child constraints that control how children resize with their frame.
completeness_note: content_constraints.js is about lock/lockPosition/lockImagePixels permissions for agent edits, not resize constraints. Searches: grep -rni 'constraint' in src/canvas/components/editor_properties/ ⇒ 0; grep -rni 'pinLeft|pinRight|constraintType|horizontalConstraint' src/ ⇒ 0 hits.

name: AI layout skills (design directions, media presets, critique)
description: Prompt/geometry library that turns a brief into an HTML layout and then editable layers.
completeness_note: Generated HTML is parsed into design nodes by the html_import_* modules (parser/style/measure/layout/flex/grid). Layout quality helpers (layout_document_quality.js, layout_art_direction.js) are heuristics, not measured tests.

name: HTML/CSS → editable layers pipeline
description: Parse generated HTML+CSS into a document using flex/grid measurement and text fidelity rules.
completeness_note: Only used for AI-generated layout previews (streaming_layout_preview.jsx, layout_action_helpers.js) — there is no user-facing File → Import HTML. No tests for the html_import_* modules (grep -rli 'html_import' tests/ ⇒ 0; the html_export_video_layer test covers export, not import).

name: Create main component from layers
description: Turn selected layers into a main component frame and leave an instance in place.
completeness_note: Context menu exposes 'Create component' and 'Detach instance' (editor.component.create / editor.component.detach). No unit test file exists for component_extract.js (grep -rli 'component_extract' tests/ ⇒ 0).

name: Component instances
description: Instance nodes that render the main component's layers and follow edits to the main.
completeness_note: Instances are live-rendered from a snapshot of the main; instance children are rows in the layers panel (editor_instance_child_rows.jsx, editor_canvas_instance_properties.jsx).

name: Instance overrides
description: Per-instance text, fill and visibility overrides without detaching.
completeness_note: Only three override fields (text, fill hex, visible). No nested-layer geometry overrides, no stroke/effect/image overrides (grep 'OVERIDDEN|override' in instance-overrides.js ⇒ the whitelist is exactly those 3), no reset-all-instance-overrides. No tests (grep -rli 'instance-overrides' tests/ ⇒ 0).

name: Component variants / properties
description: Variant sets with boolean/text/instance-swap component properties.
completeness_note: Searches: grep -rni 'variantSet|componentProperty|componentProperties|variants:' src/canvas/editor/ ⇒ 0 hits; grep -rni 'variant' src/canvas/editor/*.js ⇒ only unrelated prose (shader variant, MLS rigid variant). No variant model anywhere.

name: Nested page/canvas instances
description: Embed another page as a canvas instance with its own view/camera and playback modes.
completeness_note: Instances carry layout/playback modes but only the 'design' canvas type is supported (CANVAS_TYPES = [DESIGN]); older canvas types are read and ignored.

name: Document color variables
description: Document-scoped named color variables that layers can bind to for fill or stroke.
completeness_note: Only flat, document-level hex color variables with fill/stroke binding. No collections, no numeric/string/boolean variables, no alias/reference variables, no modes/themes (grep -rni 'modes|themes' over scene model ⇒ 0 coll/collection model). No test file for scene_color_variables.js (grep -rli 'color_variable|colorVariables' tests/ ⇒ 1, in snapshots not a dedicated suite).

name: Artifact design systems (token presets)
description: Six built-in token systems (primitive/semantic/component layers) used to style AI-generated canvases.
completeness_note: These tokens style generated output only (file comment: 'These tokens style generated canvases, not VOO chrome'). They are not document styles or variables.

name: Reusable colour styles
description: Named/shared colour styles applicable to many layers.
completeness_note: The nearest feature is document color variables; there is no style library. Searches: grep -rni 'colorStyles|paintStyles|styles:' src/canvas/editor/scene_model*.js ⇒ 0 (the only 'styles' fields are per-node paint/effect objects).

name: Reusable effect styles
description: Named/shared shadow/glow/effect style presets.
completeness_note: Only built-in starters/presets that copy values onto a node; no saved/shared effect style. Searches: grep -rni 'effectStyles|effectLibrary|savedEffects' src/ ⇒ 0 hits.

name: Layer effects (9 kinds)
description: Drop shadow, outer glow, inner shadow, inner glow, satin, bevel, fill, gradient overlay and stroke effects.
completeness_note: Effects are per-node objects rendered in Canvas2D (node_effects_shadow.js for shadow/glow). Bevel/satin are control UIs with shared helpers (effect_bevel_satin_controls.jsx).

name: 25 blend modes
description: 16 canvas-native compositing modes plus 9 PSD-only modes composited per pixel.
completeness_note: The 9 PSD-only modes (dissolve, linear-burn/dodge, vivid/linear/pin-light, hard-mix, subtract, divide) need per-pixel compositing and are only exercised through the paint/render paths; no unit test for blend_math.js.

name: Adjustment layers (21 kinds)
description: Non-destructive adjustment layer nodes with brightness/contrast/hue/saturation/levels/curves/vignette/blur and stylise filters.
completeness_note: Applied through a CPU kernel runner (cpu_adjustments*.js) and a GL pipeline (gl_adjustments*.js); curves/levels/vignette/colour-balance/selective/vibrance are separate control modules.

name: WebGL adjustment + spatial shaders
description: GPU shader pipeline for colour adjustments and spatial (blur-like) passes, with CPU fallback.
completeness_note: Shader sources split into gl_adjustments_shaders.js / gl_spatial_shaders.js; CPU kernels are the fallback (cpu_adjustments_runner.js). No tests for the GL path (headless environment has no WebGL).

name: Filter presets + pixel filters
description: Photo filter presets and per-layer pixel filters (blur/sharpen/noise/pixelate/halftone etc.).
completeness_note: Pixel filters are synchronous CPU kernels over ImageData; no dedicated test file.

name: Layer raster mask painting
description: Paint a per-layer 8-bit mask with the mask brush, with mask lifecycle (create/delete/invert/apply).
completeness_note: Mask ops + lifecycle + contour modules exist; no dedicated test (grep -rli 'editor_mask|mask_contour' tests/ ⇒ 0; the 4 'mask' test hits are clipping components in other suites).

name: Clipping masks
description: Create/release a clipping stack where layers clip to a base layer.
completeness_note: Context menu and shortcuts (⌥⌘G / ⇧⌥⌘G) create and release clip masks; command table exposes create_clipping_mask / release_clipping_mask.

name: Vector masks on paths
description: A path used as a mask shape for a layer.
completeness_note: Clipping uses the 'clipTo' node reference (vector clipping of a base by layers above) but there is no vector mask node/boolean mask affordance. Searches: grep -rni 'vectorMask|maskPath' src/ ⇒ 0 hits.

name: Quick mask / mask edit mode
description: Enter a quick-mask mode where painting edits the selection.
completeness_note: The engine exposes quickMaskFromSelection/maskSourceOf primitives, so a quick-mask selection channel exists as data, but there is no toggle UI or tests (grep -rni 'quickMask' src/canvas/components/ ⇒ 0).

name: Import images, video and audio
description: Drag/drop, paste, file picker and media source dialog import raster images, video clips and audio.
completeness_note: Images are stored as blobs in IndexedDB and decoded through bitmap_cache.js; video becomes a VIDEO node (scene-video.js). 3D/model/audio nodes exist but are beta-gated (media_section.jsx).

name: Replace image
description: Swap the bitmap behind an image layer while keeping its transform and effects.
completeness_note: replaceAsset/replaceImage only appears in 3 files, indicating a narrow path (editor_media_source → layer_image_edit); no unit test.

name: Image crop (non-destructive + destructive)
description: Crop a bitmap layer using the crop tool, with non-destructive crop geometry and a destructive commit.
completeness_note: Crop rectangle is stored on the image node and applied at paint/export time; the destructive path bakes pixels.

name: Background removal (local matting)
description: On-device matting model removes the background of an image layer and creates a mask.
completeness_note: Runs ONNX Runtime Web locally (ort_runtime.js); model weights are downloaded at first use on web and bundled on desktop (README). Matte refinement + transform modules exist (matte_refine.js).

name: AI upscale
description: Local Real-ESRGAN-style upscaling with tiling for large images.
completeness_note: Tiling (upscale_tiling.js) handles images larger than the model input; upscale_models.js declares the model set.

name: AI inpainting / repair
description: Local LaMa inpainting for selections plus healing brush repair.
completeness_note: Inpainting feeds from the pixel selection; outpaint (outpaint_*.js) extends canvas at edges. Command table exposes repaint_selection / fill_selection (content-aware fill).

name: Generative expand / outpaint
description: Extend the image canvas at a chosen direction and synthesize the new area.
completeness_note: Geometry/saliency/composite split exists (outpaint_direction.js, saliency_map.js); 18 files mention outpaint, but no dedicated test file (grep -rli 'outpaint' tests/ ⇒ 0).

name: Auto enhance, portrait retouch, saliency
description: One-click enhancement, portrait retouch plan (skin/eyes/teeth) and saliency-based selection.
completeness_note: Modules exist (apply + plan + errors) but are heuristic CPU code with no tests (grep -rli 'auto_enhance|portrait_retouch|saliency' tests/ ⇒ 0). Treat as low-confidence.

name: AI layer split
description: Decompose a flattened image into editable layers using the web chat session.
completeness_note: Declared in the platform capability registry as unavailable on standalone web (unavailableReasonKey editor.taskbar.splitLayersUnavailableWeb); requires a chat session host. No test (grep -rli 'layer_split' tests/ ⇒ 0).

name: Video layers
description: Place a video clip as a canvas layer that plays its current frame with in/out points, volume, mute and loop.
completeness_note: Each layer owns an HTMLVideoElement and plays its own loop. The module header states 'There is no shared timeline', so clips are independent — there is no playhead or multi-clip timeline.

name: Animation timeline / keyframes
description: A shared timeline with keyframes, easing and playback across layers.
completeness_note: Searches: grep -rni 'timeline' src/canvas/editor/ ⇒ 0 animation timeline (the 22 matches are i18n keys, panel layout and the storyboard node); grep -rni 'keyframe' src/ ⇒ only storyboard i18n and AI video node prompts — no canvas keyframe model. Motion controls that exist (motion toggle in properties_panel_header.jsx) are hidden behind EDITOR_BETA_ENABLED.

name: AI storyboard / shot generation
description: Storyboard node that splits a prompt into shots and renders keyframes / video clips through providers.
completeness_note: This is an AI generation workflow (prompt → shots → clips), not canvas animation. Keyframes are rendered by an external video model; the canvas itself cannot animate layers. No test for the storyboard flow.

name: Prototype interactions / hotspots
description: Link frames with click/hover interactions, transitions and an interactive prototype player.
completeness_note: Searches: grep -rniE 'prototyp|hotspot|navigate to|interaction:' src/canvas/ ⇒ 0 hits (the only 'interaction' hits are pointer/commit-boundary code). Presentation is a linear slide deck, not prototyping. This is an expected gap vs Figma/Pen.

name: Presentation decks from pages
description: Group pages into a presentation with slide size, order and page menu.
completeness_note: Presentation metadata is validated (version, pageIds, width/height) and owned by a page node. There is no test file for the presentation subsystem (grep -rli 'presentation' tests/ ⇒ 1 hit, unrelated).

name: Slide viewer / presenter runtime
description: Full-screen slide playback reading live editor pages or snapshots.
completeness_note: Viewer renders slides through readPresentationPage (live engine or snapshot); no presenter notes/audience window, and no test coverage.
notes: No speaker-notes model found (grep 'speakerNotes|presenterNotes' src/ ⇒ 0 except PPTX notes XML which writes empty notes).

name: PPTX export
description: Export the deck as a real .pptx zip with slides, shapes, text, images and notes parts.
completeness_note: A hand-written OOXML package writer (content types, rels, slide master, notes master). Unsupported nodes are rasterised and reported as warnings. No tests (grep -rli 'pptx' tests/ ⇒ 0).

name: Deck PDF export
description: Export the deck to PDF.
completeness_note: Exposed in the presentation export dialog (pptx/pdf toggle). Shares the raster/vector limitations of the slide renderer; untested.

name: Presentation export dialog
description: Deck export UI with format choice, progress, cancel and warning list.
completeness_note: Own history stack (use_presentation_history.js) and page menu; no tests.

name: PNG / JPEG / WebP export
description: Raster export at 1x-4x scale with JPEG/WebP quality, whole frame/selection/slices ranges.
completeness_note: Export dialog formats are png/jpeg/webp/svg/psd/pdf (editor_export_dialog.jsx FORMATS). Slices come from regions (editor_export_regions.js).

name: SVG / PDF / PSD export
description: Vector SVG, vector PDF and layered PSD export of the current document.
completeness_note: PSD export writes layers with masks/baked adjustments (editor_export_api.js renderNodeImageData). PDF is the design PDF path (distinct from presentation-pdf.js).

name: HTML/CSS handoff
description: Export the design as a standalone HTML page with CSS-positioned editable layers.
completeness_note: Complex vectors fall back to inline SVG; instances respect overrides. Also exposed as 'Copy HTML/CSS' in the context menu (copyHtmlCss).

name: Figma .fig export
description: Write a real .fig container (kiwi-encoded schema, zip directory) for frames/rects/ellipses.
completeness_note: Full container/round-trip tests exist (figma-fig-roundtrip.test.js), but only frames/rect/ellipse with solid fills are writable — text, vectors, images and effects are lossy (figSaveLosses reports kinds/fills).

name: Slices / region export
description: Define export regions and export all slices, or export only the current selection.
completeness_note: Region nodes (NODE_KIND.REGION) double as slices; export dialog offers frame/selection/slices range. No dedicated test.

name: Import .voo / SVG / PSD / FIG
description: Open native .voo plus convert SVG, PSD and Figma .fig files into .voo documents.
completeness_note: FIG import is the deepest importer (schema data, kiwi, text, vectors, glyphs, instances, effects — 12 figma test files). PSD import reads layers; SVG imports parse shapes/text/images.

name: Import raster/video/audio media
description: Place images and clips onto the canvas from file picker, drag/drop or clipboard.
completeness_note: Images are downsized for display (bitmap_display_downscale) and stored full-res as blobs.

name: Import Pen.app .pen files
description: Open a Pen.app (pen.dev) .pen document.
completeness_note: Searches: grep -rniE '\.pen\b|pen\.dev|pen file' src/ electron/ ⇒ only the pen TOOL and its i18n keys; SAVE_FORMATS has no 'pen'. No parser, no importer.

name: Import HTML file
description: Open an arbitrary .html file as a design.
completeness_note: The HTML→layers parser exists but is only wired to AI streaming layout previews (layout_action_helpers.js, streaming_layout_preview.jsx). project_io.js opens only voo/svg/psd/fig, so a user cannot import an HTML file. Searches: grep -rn 'html_import' src/canvas/store/ ⇒ 0.

name: Import PDF
description: Open a PDF as editable design layers.
completeness_note: Searches: grep -rni 'pdf' src/canvas/store/project_io.js ⇒ 0; grep -rni 'pdf.js|pdfjs|pdf-lib' src/ ⇒ 0. PDF is export-only.

name: On-device AI models (matting, upscale, inpaint, repair)
description: Four local ONNX pipelines loaded from bundled/desktop files or downloaded on first use.
completeness_note: Model weights excluded from the repo (README): bundled in the desktop installer, downloaded from VITE_MODEL_BASE_URL on web. Model install/loading is test-covered; inference quality is not.

name: Image/video generation providers
description: Multi-provider generation routes (OpenAI, Google, DashScope, Volcengine, 302, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Zhipu, Jimeng, Tripo, Midjourney).
completeness_note: The direct-HTTP provider modules and provider_registry.js are present (24 provider files incl. 18 provider_* engines, OpenAI/Google/DashScope/Volcengine/302/OpenRouter/DeepSeek/Zhipu/MiniMax/local/CLI), and agent/image_generation.js runImageJob dispatches through the registry. BUT the legacy src/canvas/provider_client.js that the rest of the app uses is a stub whose submit/stream/fetch/ASR functions throw "not configured in standalone mode", and listProviderModels returns []. So: registry path = real; legacy path (AI layout generation, AI layer repaint, provider model lists in settings) = disabled in this build. See ai.direct_api_broken.

name: AI design/layout generation
description: Prompt to generated design canvas (HTML streamed, parsed to layers) with design-system and layout-skill presets.
completeness_note: streamLayoutText (store/layout_action_helpers.js) has two lanes: CLI model ids (claude:/codex:/antigravity:) go through the real desktop CLI bridge and work; every other model id goes through provider_client.js streamProviderText/submitProviderJob, which are stubbed to throw in the standalone build. So AI layout generation currently only works on desktop with a CLI agent configured. There is no test for layout_action_helpers.

name: Agent canvas tool schemas
description: LLM function-calling schemas for canvas actions (image generation, selection description).
completeness_note: Only 2 tools in the in-canvas agent schema (generate_image, describe_selection); the much larger 40-command surface is the editor command table exposed separately to the command bridge/MCP.

name: Local CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity)
description: Detect, probe, stream and cancel locally installed coding-agent CLIs as the editor's AI backend.
completeness_note: Antigravity is opt-in (ANTIGRAVITY_OPT_IN_KEY, experimental). Claude Code is the default agent (src/shared/agent-defaults.js).

name: Dual-channel CLI bridge (Electron IPC + web loopback)
description: One client interface over desktop IPC and a ws://127.0.0.1:4179 loopback server with origin guard.
completeness_note: Heavily tested (protocol, stress, adversarial). Desktop path needs the Electron app; web path needs the user to run the bridge script.

name: MCP server for canvas tools
description: Model Context Protocol endpoint exposing list_tools/call_tool over HTTP for external agents.
completeness_note: Implements initialize/list_tools/call_tool with a 4 MB body cap; no MCP-specific test file.

name: Agent panel with plan steps + status pill
description: Right-hand chat panel with transcript, active model pill, streaming plan/step cards and tool-call cards.
completeness_note: Turn execution, plan steps and undo integration covered by agent_panel_dispatch/contextual_island tests.

name: Contextual island bar
description: Floating selection taskbar that captures node context (id/type/dimensions) and dispatches quick AI prompts.
completeness_note: 20 tests cover selection context extraction, dispatch and undo/redo safety.

name: Agent session history
description: Persisted per-thread agent conversation history.
completeness_note: Local persistence only; no server-side conversation store.

name: P2P collaboration session + protocol
description: Room/session state machine, framed protocol, chunked binary blobs, presence, WebRTC transport and stroke bus.
completeness_note: The collaboration stack is fully written (12 modules: session, protocol, chunking, presence, identity, stroke bus, WebRTC, room, config, lifecycle) but NO module imports createCollabSession and collab/use_collab.js is a standalone stub returning status 'off'. So live collaboration is dead code in this build. No collab tests (grep -rli 'collab' tests/ ⇒ 0).
notes: Search: grep -rn 'collab/session' src/ ⇒ definition only; grep -rn 'createCollabSession' src/ ⇒ 1 hit (definition).

name: Presence colour + identity UI
description: Guest/name identity fields and avatar initials in settings.
completeness_note: Identity name/avatar editing works locally (settings_general.jsx imports collab/identity + presence), but there are no peers to show because the session is never started.

name: Share link / room URL
description: Create /r/<id> room links bound to a workflow with a 7-day TTL.
completeness_note: Room id/URL helpers and share_actions exist, but shareWorkflow requires a collabSession that is never constructed (see file.cloud_share_link). Share is present in the UI surface yet cannot complete.

name: Canvas comments / sticky notes
description: Leave comments anchored to canvas positions, with threads and resolve state.
completeness_note: Searches: grep -rln 'comment' src/ ⇒ 6 files, all i18n/fig-zip-directory/layout-output — no comment model, no comment UI. The annotation module is for marking reference images sent to AI models, not for collaborative comments.

name: AI reference-image annotations
description: Draw numbered point/box annotations on a reference image before sending it to an AI model.
completeness_note: Annotations are normalised 0-1 coordinates with notes; used for image-editing prompts. Separate from design comments. No test file.

name: Dev mode / inspect panel
description: Inspect layer CSS/measurements and hand off code like Figma Dev Mode.
completeness_note: Code handoff is limited to Copy HTML/CSS, Copy SVG and full-page HTML export. Searches: grep -rniE 'devMode|dev_mode|inspect panel|codegen' src/ ⇒ 0 hits; no measurement overlay, no React/Tailwind codegen, no inspect sidebar.

name: Framework code generation (React/Tailwind)
description: Generate component code from a selection.
completeness_note: Searches: grep -rniE 'react codegen|jsx.*generate|tailwind class' src/canvas/editor/ ⇒ 0 codegen results (Tailwind only appears as editor chrome styling). HTML/CSS is the ceiling.

name: Computer-use browser extension integration
description: Toggle that lets the agent drive a connected browser extension.
completeness_note: A single hard-coded integration with a persisted toggle, not a plugin system.

name: Third-party plugin API
description: Load community plugins/extensions with their own UI and API surface.
completeness_note: 'Plugins & Skills' is a catalog of workflow/agent skills (content cards), not a runtime plugin API. Searches: grep -rniE 'registerPlugin|pluginAPI|loadPlugin|manifest.json' src/ ⇒ 0 hits.

name: R-tree spatial index
description: STR-bulk-loaded 2D R-tree for hit-testing and range queries.
completeness_note: 14 unit tests plus 14 stress tests (challenger_spatial_viewport_stress) cover packing, insertion and queries.

name: Bitmap cache + image mipmaps
description: LRU decoded-bitmap cache (128 entries) keyed by image id, with lower-res mip levels for zoomed-out display.
completeness_note: Cache owns blob fetch, decode, draw and URL revocation; failures surface as asset placeholders (asset_unavailable.js) with retry.

name: Render cache + dirty repaint routing
description: Cache static node rasters and route repaints only through changed layers.
completeness_note: renderer_flag.js switches renderers; layer_repaint.js handles partial repaint. No dedicated tests.

name: Full keyboard shortcut map
description: Tool keys, shift variants, command keys and history shortcuts across the editor.
completeness_note: 62 key bindings in use_editor_shortcuts.js; the catalog groups them for the in-app reference modal (shortcut_reference_modal.jsx).

name: Shortcut reference modal
description: In-app searchable cheat sheet of every shortcut.
completeness_note: Both a modal and a settings section render the same catalog, so docs cannot drift from the pipeline.

name: Editor command table (40 commands)
description: Agent-facing command surface with JSON schemas, validation, errors, receipts, undo metadata and gesture previews.
completeness_note: All 40 definitions have implementations (verified by name across implementations_part1-4 + executor gesture map). Exposed through editor_command_bridge.js and MCP.

name: Settings drawer
description: Right-side settings drawer with general/profile, workspace directory, language, providers/models, shortcuts and onboarding re-trigger.
completeness_note: Section components are split (general, providers, shortcuts); language switch is en/zh only.

name: Workspace directory configuration
description: Choose/scan a project directory and back it with the right storage driver.
completeness_note: Three-tier fallback (Electron FS → FSA → IndexedDB) with permission states; tested across all three.

name: First-launch onboarding guide
description: Four-step wizard: workspace setup → agent select → live CLI detection → ready.
completeness_note: PROJECT.md documents a 3-step guide; the code ships 4 steps (GUIDE_STEPS keeps the legacy 3-step list for old tests). Step 2 probes the CLI binary and offers a copyable install command.

name: Onboarding persistence + CI bypass
description: Show onboarding until completed version + workspace path are set; skip under navigator.webdriver.
completeness_note: Automation bypass is explicit in code (navigator.webdriver) and covered by adversarial tests.

name: ARIA labels and focus rings
description: Accessible names on icon buttons and visible focus rings across panels, including design-token lint enforcement.
completeness_note: 107 component files use aria-label and 62 use focus-visible; align_section.test.jsx asserts focus-visible tokens. But there is no automated a11y audit, no keyboard-trap tests for modals, and the canvas itself is a single paint surface with no accessible node tree (grep -rni 'role="tree"|aria-activedescendant' src/canvas/components/editor_layers.jsx ⇒ 0).

name: English + Chinese dictionaries with key parity
description: Full en/zh i18n with ~3,400 keys and a t() helper.
completeness_note: Only two locales exist (en, zh) — no ja/es/fr/de/RTL. Key parity is asserted in comments (en.js header) and exercised indirectly by UI tests.

name: Runtime language switching
description: Language selector in settings that switches the whole UI at runtime.
completeness_note: Persists through shared settings; no per-document locale and no locale negotiation (browser language detection not present).

name: .voo container format
description: Versioned JSON-forward container embedding document trees and image bytes.
completeness_note: Format is versioned (v1) with a JSON payload plus binary image table; binary tests cover encode/decode and bad-input rejection.

name: IndexedDB persistence (documents + image blobs)
description: Local durable store for workspace files, image blobs and generated assets.
completeness_note: Also backs the web IDB workspace driver; quota errors surface through persistence_contract.js (isQuotaError).

name: Serialised save queue
description: Queue writes so concurrent saves cannot interleave or corrupt a document.
completeness_note: Draft save queue is debounced and serialised inside editor-autosave.js; pixel flush failures raise EDITOR_PIXEL_SAVE_FAILED. NOTE: store/share_actions.js and store/template_ugc.js import a non-existent ./persistence.js (see WEAKNESSES §2) but neither module is imported by the app, so the broken import is not in the build graph.

name: Rename frame/page in place
description: Double-click a frame header to rename it; Enter/blur commits, Escape cancels, empty restores the default.
completeness_note: Rename is inline with explicit commit/cancel semantics; no test for the rename keyboard paths.

name: Duplicate / delete page
description: Duplicate or delete a canvas from the page menu.
completeness_note: Page duplicate/delete also appear in the context menu (editor.pages.duplicateCanvas / deleteCanvas).

name: Canvas size presets + custom size
description: Preset artboard sizes (social/web/print plus platform presets) with search and clamped custom size.
completeness_note: Sizes are data with MIN/MAX clamps; the add-canvas rail and popover share the same table.

name: Free artboard positioning
description: Each artboard keeps an independent position on the infinite stage.
completeness_note: Positions are independent of workflow node coordinates and clamped to +/-1e6; no test.

name: Canvas background / transparent
description: Set the canvas background colour including transparent with preset swatches.
completeness_note: Stored on the document and painted by the base renderer (render_canvas_base.js, which also draws the transparency checkerboard).

name: Tool options sub-bar
description: Contextual bar showing mode toggles and erase/paint mode for the active tool.
completeness_note: Sub-bar is driven by tool family metadata (tool_families.js); each family supplies its own mode list.

name: Stylus pressure for size/opacity
description: Brush stamps scale size and opacity by pen pressure with configurable strength.
completeness_note: Pressure is sampled from pointer events and bucketed per whole pixel for cache stability; no test for pressure maths.

name: Searchable font picker
description: Font dropdown with search over bundled and Google families and per-family weight specs.
completeness_note: Weight options come from the Google index family spec so unsupported weights are not offered.

name: Text align + tracking + leading
description: Left/center/right alignment, letter spacing and line height with bounds and scrub inputs.
completeness_note: Also italic/underline toggles; no vertical-align/paragraph spacing controls (grep 'paragraphSpacing|textAlignVertical' src/ ⇒ 0).

name: Arrow-key nudge
description: Arrow keys move the selection by 1px (10px with Shift), coalesced into one history snapshot per burst.
completeness_note: Nudging an anchor while in pen edit mode moves the anchor instead of the node.

name: Convert shape to editable path
description: Turn rect/ellipse/polygon/star/line/arrow into a pen path with bezier corner approximations.
completeness_note: Uses the standard 4/3*(sqrt2-1) bezier circle constant so ellipse->path round-trips visually.

name: Combine section (boolean selector)
description: Properties section for choosing the boolean operation of a boolean node.
completeness_note: Works on an existing boolean node; the four operations are also in the context menu and shortcuts.

name: Histogram + clipping stats
description: Per-channel/luma histogram with black/white/mean/median points and clipping warnings.
completeness_note: Feeds the tone controls and the auto-enhance planner; no dedicated test file.

name: Levels / curves / tone LUT
description: Levels and tone curves baked into LUT textures for CPU/GL adjustment rendering.
completeness_note: LUT modules split by concern (curves/signatures/tables/texture/vignette); widget draws the curve editor.

name: Direct-API AI routes in the standalone build
description: Run AI jobs through the user's own provider keys (DeepSeek/OpenAI/etc.) rather than a CLI agent.

repo_evidence.symbol: submitProviderJob/streamProviderText throw 'Cloud AI generation runtime is not configured in standalone mode.'

completeness_note: ALL hosted/cloud calls through the legacy provider client are stubbed out: submitProviderJob, fetchProviderJob, streamProviderJob, streamProviderText, submitAsrJob, fetchAsrJob throw; testProvider returns {success:false}; listProviderModels returns []; getProviderConfig returns null. Consumers: store/layout_action_helpers.js (AI layout generation), editor/layer_repaint.js (AI repaint), provider_card/provider_model_list/settings (empty model lists). The newer provider_registry.js path (used by agent/image_generation.js runImageJob) still dispatches to real provider_*.js HTTP modules, and CLI models (claude:/codex:) route to the desktop CLI bridge. So: local ONNX AI works, CLI-agent AI works on desktop, direct-API AI is effectively disabled.
notes: Search: grep -rn 'standalone mode' src/; grep -rn provider_client src/

name: Local backend capability vocabulary
description: Single source of truth for which media a local backend can produce, read by providers and settings badges.
completeness_note: Deliberately dependency-free so providers.js can import it without cycles.

name: CLI provider engine (Claude/Codex/OpenCode/Antigravity as text backend)
description: Text generation backed by a locally installed CLI using the user's own login, desktop-only.
completeness_note: In non-desktop shells the CLI provider honestly reports not-configured (cliBridgeAvailable gates on window.vooDesktop.localCli).

name: Codex/Claude model catalogs
description: Declared model lists per CLI agent, with aliases resolved by the CLI at runtime.
completeness_note: Some catalogs are evidence-based (Claude Opus 5.5 firstParty) while aliases are delegated to the CLI.

name: Provider + model settings
description: Provider cards with key entry, verification state, model list and route badges.
completeness_note: UI is complete, but model lists depend on listProviderModels which the standalone provider client stubs to [] — so direct-API providers show no models in this build (see ai.direct_api_broken).

name: Agent settings (default agent/model, image prefs)
description: Choose the default CLI agent and model plus image-generation defaults and confirmation toggles.
completeness_note: Defaults: claude:claude-opus-5-5 (agent-defaults.js); image presets 1024x1024/1024x1536/1536x1024.

name: Re-open onboarding from title bar / settings
description: Any surface can dispatch voo:open-onboarding to show the guide again.
completeness_note: Draft step/selection state persists so reopening resumes mid-flow.

name: Local user profile / guest identity
description: Guest profile with editable name, avatar seed and initials, stored locally.
completeness_note: No real auth/session: isLoggedIn is always false for the guest profile, and the account avatar i18n exists but there is no server login.

name: Generated-asset library with LRU budget
description: Every generated picture is kept in an asset library independent of the graph, evicted LRU past a byte cap.
completeness_note: Sits on three IDB stores (assets/images/thumbnails); referenced assets are never evicted. No test for eviction.

name: Image pyramid tiers
description: Selects a mip tier by on-screen scale so zoomed-out images decode/paint smaller rasters.
completeness_note: Tier thresholds are settings (PYRAMID_SETTINGS); the cache stores the decoded bitmap per tier.

name: History panel with undo/redo jump
description: Visual history list of editor actions with undo/redo and jump-to-state.
completeness_note: History entries carry labels and action ids (editor_undo_actions.js); agent mutations commit through commitEditorDocument so they land in the same stack.

name: Export warnings + receipt
description: Report lossy/unsupported export content and a completion receipt with the saved filename.
completeness_note: Warnings surface in the export dialog (onExportWarnings) and presentation export has its own warnings list.

name: Open files from the workspace
description: Scan the configured workspace directory and open any discovered project from the dashboard.
completeness_note: Category guess (landing/mobile/slides/dashboard/web) is filename-heuristic (guessCategory).

name: Keyboard navigation of editor chrome
description: Tab order, Escape-to-close and focus return for panels, menus and modals.
completeness_note: Export dialog has a dedicated keyboard hook and align/settings tests assert focus rings. No modal focus-trap implementation was found (grep -rni 'focusTrap|trapFocus' src/ ⇒ 0) and no a11y test for the canvas itself.

name: Localised provider/agent strings
description: Provider names, model labels and agent connection states all resolve through i18n keys.
completeness_note: Labels are keys rather than literals, so the agent picker localises; en/zh only.
